[ffff64]Pupalov Sector[ffffff]
What's this place?\nIt somehow feels different from all the other\nplaces we've been to...
Of course it's different.\nThe buildings here weren't built in Darkan style.
I've never seen a place like this before.\nWhat actually is...
K-kyaaaaaaa!!
What? These skulls...\nThey look like humans', but they aren't.\nWhat the heck are they??
Perhaps, homunculus...
H-homunculus??\nWhat's that...?
How should I put it...an artificial human,\nI guess?
A lot of them were created by the Elves during\nancient times and I heard they were made to mine\nthe Goddess Beads...
Humans created humans...\nDo you mean they created living creatures that\nlook like humans?!
Yeah. However, since their existence was regarded\nas a violation of the natural order, I heard they\nwere locked away near the root of Eldenbaum.
Then an adventurer in the past found them and\nproposed that they could live in the upper part of\nEldenbaum if they stopped their population from
growing and limited their interaction with\nhumans...that's the story.
I see...\nBut why are the skulls scattered all around the\nplace like this?
I guess the skulls here belong to the last batch\nof homunculi created.
Because they all died at almost the same time,\nno one was there to clean up the mess and it was\nabandoned...
Oh...that's so sad...
Things like this are bound to happen sometimes...
The same goes for us.\nIf we all get killed later, no one's gonna mourn\nour death...
You're right...
For peddlers like us too. No one's gonna give a\nmonkey's even if we lie dead in the middle of the\nstreet...
Oh my gawdddd!!
I can't believe Coenubias are even in a place like\nthis!! Let's finish them quickly and hurry to the\nnext area!
